verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms is API-driven and can run without a UI. Docs describe API-only onboarding (build your own UI and submit data through API requests), plus the Legal Entity Management and Configuration APIs for creating resources. Webhooks push asynchronous status changes to your endpoint so you don't have to poll, and test credentials let you exercise integrations, which suits automated pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline guidance, an official CLI or SDK for scripted runs, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
